text: Ohio state championship, 2012. The 3200 meters. Meghan Vogel was near the back, exhausted. Just ahead, Arden McMath *collapsed* a few meters from the finish. Vogel could have run past her. Instead she *lifted her up and helped her to the line,* then pushed her across first. Officially, Vogel finished behind her. Earlier in the meet, she had won the state title in the 1600. Like if you'd stop too.
title: The Runner Who Finished Last on Purpose 🏃🤝
alt_titles: Carried to the Line by Her Rival 🏃🤝
